items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: The interviewee discusses the 'Albert system' of clarinet keywork, stating 'I always liked an Albert for playing with a small band.' There is no mention of a person named Albert, only the mechanical system.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's an Albert system. Yeah. That may be the same type of keys or something.

Yeah. Now they, they, they, they uh. The settlement that I just bought in France is made just like it got four rings. I bought another clinet from a fella in Boston that got six rings. That was the first six ring Albert time in my life. So. I was playing just before I left one. But mostly all the clinet is made. Does it bother you, the extra ring? No, no, I like the rings. It wouldn't affect it all. I don't know why they make four or five rings, but I don't know. It's going to make a difference to me, just rings…
